scope: Public page content, navigation and direct HTTP reads. No wallet, authentication, purchase, mint, betting or signed-message actions were performed. Site claims were not independently verified against contracts or production game servers.

positioning.summary: A game-first persistent science-fiction universe, with story, combat, autonomous/human Actors and durable history. The premium game and the Trends engagement should be described separately.

relationships.evidence: The homepage identifies AI Wars as a Vertical Foundation project and links to the foundation.
Whitepaper describes durable records and ownership beneath real-time gameplay. The mint page specifies NFTs on Vitruveo, with payments on BNB Chain.
Homepage describes an external observation/data relationship; the game is not controlled by the market.
Genesis links to an existing VTRU bridge at scope.vitruveo.ai. This is a linked infrastructure journey, not evidence of a separate AI Wars ownership role.

audiences.basis: Inference from world, combat and Actor design in the whitepaper.

audiences.audience: Vitruveo community members and prospective early holders
audiences.basis: Genesis explicitly addresses the Vitruveo community; shard pages describe holder access.
Separate engagement with VTRU stakes and shard-credit rules; no claim of audience size or suitability.

observed_statuses.status: Vision and future roadmap, not verified as publicly playable
observed_statuses.evidence: Roadmap places Arena after Foundations and gives later alpha, prologue and Early Access milestones. Dates are conditional on funding.

observed_statuses.status: Public page available; rendered UI says opening soon
observed_statuses.evidence: Mint page has a wallet CTA and staged sale details, but no mint was attempted.

observed_statuses.status: Public explanation and onboarding; opening soon displayed
observed_statuses.evidence: Referral/claim mechanics and bridge/buy/refer/redeem steps already exist. Benefits are site claims.

observed_statuses.status: Public sector interface and FAQ available
observed_statuses.evidence: Site explains terrain previews, holder beacons and signing. HTML showed no lit sectors. Interactive rendering/signing was not tested.

observed_statuses.status: Public engagement labelled live; telemetry explicitly simulated
observed_statuses.evidence: Page says the live game feed is not yet connected. Wallet-gated play, stake/settlement rules and leaderboard exist; execution was not tested.

observed_statuses.status: Public engagement explanation and roster surface available
observed_statuses.evidence: One operative per shard, backstory/portrait and future game carry-over are described. HTML showed loading dispatch and zero enlisted; generation was not tested.

existing_resources_to_reuse.resource: Public release/sprint roadmap and funding model
Shard explanation, tier readout and activation information
Genesis onboarding and existing bridge link
Existing Meridian/Archive/fleet imagery and narrative treatments
existing_resources_to_reuse.qualification: Visible marketing assets exist. Root is auditing actual asset files; approval/licensing and preferred current assets require owner confirmation.

needs_confirmation.evidence: Roadmap marks Foundations delivered and describes Genesis/shard sale as in production, while their rendered pages show opening soon.

needs_confirmation.issue: Live interface versus live game telemetry
needs_confirmation.evidence: Trends contains both live-product wording and an explicit simulated-feed qualification. Promotions must not imply the main game feed is already connected.
Future gameplay perks, beta entry, referrals, reward credits and dated releases need current owner-approved wording; public copy alone does not verify delivery.

reuse: Link to the existing whitepaper, roadmap, shard explanation, Scape FAQ and Trends rulebook rather than recreate them.
Use owner-approved existing world art and user-supplied ZIP marks for campaign materials.
improve: Reconcile public status labels and distinguish product availability from telemetry readiness.
Create short campaign-specific summaries and channel assets that lead to existing canonical destinations.
possible_gap: A clearly discoverable public support/contact entry, press/brand-kit index and social-channel directory were not observed in the reviewed navigation.
Consider a concise no-wallet new-visitor route if owners confirm the current pages do not already meet that need.
reuse_improve_possible_gap.qualification: These are bounded discoverability findings and potential improvements, not proof that private, unlinked or other-domain resources do not exist. No replacement site or product build is recommended from this audit alone.

method_limits: Read-only public HTML and web-reader evidence; client-side actions were not exercised.
Direct HTTP reads were checked on the stated date; cached web-reader content sometimes differed in details, so current direct HTML was used for status qualification.
Only this current first-party domain and linked public destinations were assessed; legacy AI Wars/Trends material was not treated as a complete description of the current game.
No audience metrics, production telemetry integrity, ownership, license rights or commercial promises were independently validated.
